<!-- docs-drift-check -->
### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **1** package(s): `@objectstack/spec`, touching **10** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **4** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/liveness/view.json`, `packages/spec/src/migrations/registry.ts.template`, `packages/spec/variant-docs.json`, …), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**3** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/protocol/objectui/concept.mdx`  _(via FormViewSchema (symbol, a top-level const))_
- `content/docs/protocol/objectui/index.mdx`  _(via FormViewSchema (symbol, a top-level const))_
- `content/docs/protocol/objectui/layout-dsl.mdx`  _(via FormViewSchema (symbol, a top-level const))_

⛔ **3** release-owned page(s) also name something this change touched. These are **read-only**:

- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-1.mdx`  _(via GanttConfigSchema (symbol, a top-level const))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-3.mdx`  _(via FormViewSchema (symbol, a top-level const), ViewDataSchema (symbol, a top-level const))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-4.mdx`  _(via GanttConfigSchema (symbol, a top-level const))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **4** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/liveness/view.json`, `packages/spec/src/migrations/registry.ts.template`, `packages/spec/variant-docs.json`, …) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **3** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **54** of **206** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **141** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json dc93781c1947b53cff50a550ad551e462a464594` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `c9876c263d6f588d9f934bfcc6a7dd3f08e56430` — the merge of head `12f86031637d7aaffe0ce28819166fb55bad8931` into base `dc93781c1947b53cff50a550ad551e462a464594`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin c9876c263d6f588d9f934bfcc6a7dd3f08e56430 && git checkout c9876c263d6f588d9f934bfcc6a7dd3f08e56430
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin dc93781c1947b53cff50a550ad551e462a464594 12f86031637d7aaffe0ce28819166fb55bad8931 && git checkout -B drift-repro dc93781c1947b53cff50a550ad551e462a464594 && git merge --no-ff 12f86031637d7aaffe0ce28819166fb55bad8931

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json dc93781c1947b53cff50a550ad551e462a464594
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs dc93781c1947b53cff50a550ad551e462a464594` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `be64fe6648c2175f6ef7dc24523ae79ba41d0fba`
Local-runs: none

Inputs read: card #23082 (body and all 4 comments, ruling `6134088274` letter C, claim `6136106180`, dev report `6138457534`), PR #23160 (body, 23-file list, net diff against `main`), the 39 check-runs on the head, and `origin/main` objects by `git show` / `git grep` for context. Nothing built, run or re-run.

**Check-runs on the head as read for this record:** 27 completed `success`; `skipped`: `Console Pin Gate` (its `if:` excludes `pull_request` and `merge_group` events — it never runs on a PR head, so its verdict is not available here), `Dogfood Verify CLI`, `Dogfood Regression Gate (matrix)`, `Packed-tarball smoke`, `Temporal Conformance`; still `in_progress` and therefore NOT assumed: `Build Core`, `Test Core (1/6)` through `(6/6)`, `Type Check · workspace`, `Type Check · debt ledger`. Those carry the retirement pin, the absence walk and the narrowed `ViewData` type across the workspace; the dev's local reads of them are claims until these runs complete.

### ① Derived judgments

Accept set and public surface, each judged:

1. **`ViewDataSchema` loses its `api` arm — RIGHT.** `data.provider: 'api'` on a list or form view (and through `ViewSchema.list.data`) is refused at parse with the prescription on the union's `error` map keyed on the input's `provider === 'api'`, at path `provider` / `data.provider` (`invalid_union`); any other unknown provider keeps zod's own report listing `object`, `value`, `schema`; the three surviving arms are value-identical and still closed. This is ruling C, executed on the `ViewDataSchema` branch only: `HttpRequestSchema` / `HttpMethodSubsetSchema` (`shared/http.zod.ts`) are untouched and still imported and re-exported from `ui/view.zod.ts` (lines 87 and 108 on `origin/main`), and the page element's `ElementApiDataSourceSchema` (`ui/page.zod.ts`) is not in the file list.
2. **`ViewData` type narrows (the arm leaves `z.input` / `z.infer`) — RIGHT, no in-repo casualty.** On `origin/main` no `src/` outside `packages/spec` imports `ViewData` / `ViewDataSchema`; the only `case 'api':` in a runtime package (`service-automation/src/engine.ts`) switches on a trigger kind, and `packages/lint`'s `validate-preset-comparands.ts` reads `r.data.provider` without comparing it to `'api'` (its two test fixtures move to the `value` arm in this diff). The workspace-wide answer is `Type Check · workspace`, in progress.
3. **Four ratchets byte-identical, `HttpRequest` defs orphaned but still exported — RIGHT.** `authorable-surface.base.json`, `api-surface/`, `export-origins/`, `declaration-map/` and `json-schema.manifest/` record `shared/HttpRequest:*` and `ui/HttpRequest:*` by def name and carry no leaf path under the `api` arm, so a value retirement cannot move them; the orphan is recorded, not acted on, per the ruling's "touches only the `ViewDataSchema` branch".
4. **Prescription names a release that will not exist — WRONG.** `VIEW_DATA_API_PROVIDER_RETIRED` says "was removed in @objectstack/spec 17.8.0", the retirement pin asserts that exact string (`PRESCRIPTION` regex, `17\.8\.0`), and the changeset quotes it verbatim for `CHANGELOG.md`. `origin/main` is in Changesets pre mode (`.changeset/pre.json`: `mode: pre`, tag `next`) with pending `major` changesets on the fixed group that includes `@objectstack/spec` (`22080-v18-line-opens`, `22130-protocol-18`, the `19939-flow-*` set and others), so the first release carrying this removal is `18.0.0-next.N` and the first stable one is `18.0.0`; a `17.8.0` on this line is not a version that will ship this change. The six prescriptions added to `packages/spec/src` since the v18 line opened all stamp the bare major (`17`), none a minted minor. The FROM column's "17.7 and earlier" is right (17.7.0 is the newest published stable). Fix: the schema string, the test regex and the changeset quotation, in the house form the kit prescribes for the open line (the `spec-property-retirement` skill writes `was removed in @objectstack/spec [version] (ADR-XXXX)` without saying what the version is under pre mode — see ③ item E). A wrong version in a released CHANGELOG entry can only be amended by a dedicated docs-only PR later (AGENTS.md, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` row), which is why it must be right before landing.
5. **Four published describes still teach the arm — WRONG, in this PR's own surface.** `packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts` lines 5743 (ObjectGrid `data`), 8695 (ObjectMap), 9245 (ObjectTree) and 9821 (ObjectGantt) on `origin/main` describe `data` as "ViewDataSchema — discriminated on `provider`: object | api | value | schema". The diff does not touch them, and its own regenerated `content/docs/references/ui/component.mdx` hunks show that sentence beside the narrowed three-arm type column. These are the shipped JSON-schema descriptions and reference pages an author reads; they now teach a discriminator value the contract refuses. The dev's absence matcher cannot see them (it anchors on a `data: {` block), and the PR body's "two stale prose sites in the same file" covers `view.zod.ts` only. Fix: the four describes plus `gen:docs`. (`shared/polarity-axes.ts` line 100 carries a source-comment table row naming "the `api` data source" — comment only, cosmetic, fold in if touched.)
6. **ADR-0087 disposition: D3 `view-data-api-provider-retired`, STEP18 rationale fragment, no D2 — RIGHT.** The registry generator discovers one file per semantic entry under `entries/semantic/18.*.ts`, the gate resolves a `registered` id against that directory, and `Check Changeset` is green on the head. The no-D2 reasoning holds: the replacement is a binding on a different metadata type, and the only mechanical edit (deleting the view's `data`) would silently re-bind the view to its object; the `rest-api-endpoint-handler-status-retired` precedent is the same shape. Shared `order` values in `STEP18_RATIONALE` are ordinary (several fragments already share 86–92).
7. **Liveness ledger: `list.data` and `form.data` stay `live` with the arm's retirement record on the key's row — RIGHT; the pin label is stale — WRONG in detail.** The skill's route table keeps a key whose surviving arms are read, and the walk never descends a union arm, so the record sits on the row. But the new `list.data.evidence` cites `objectui @7578323a544e` and the PR body and changeset call that "the objectui pin": `.objectui-sha` is `1fb1ced36243` at `origin/main` and already at `287fd6e5d`, the main this head merged (moved by PR #23110, which the claim itself lists as a concurrent PR). A citation at a named SHA is the ledger's tolerated form (other rows cite `@4997995022f8`, `@ab1879721595`, `@db11afd4967c`, `@9dfaca654311`), so `Spec property liveness` is green, but the label "the pin" is one hop stale and the next pin-citation re-measure will have to re-read `ListView.tsx` / `ObjectGantt.tsx` at `1fb1ced36243`. Fix with the two items above: cite the pin the head actually carries, or say "measured at `7578323a544e`" without calling it the pin.
8. **Hand-written `error` map on the discriminated union versus the kit's rule — judged acceptable, gap escalated (③ item F).** The `spec-property-retirement` skill (rule added 2026-09-30, #20828) says an enum-value narrowing hangs its prescription on `enumWithRetiredValues()` and no longer hand-writes an `error` map. That helper wraps a `z.enum`; `provider` here is a per-arm `z.literal` discriminator of a `z.discriminatedUnion`, which the helper cannot wrap, and the only in-tree precedent for a union arm (the bare-string `sort` clause, #17914, `LIST_VIEW_SORT_STRING_RETIRED`) is exactly this hand-written shape. The dev's map keeps the helper's discipline (a literal comparison, returns `undefined` for every other input so zod's report stands) and the pin controls it (`provider: 'rest'`, a non-object input). Right on substance; the kit owes a helper or a written exception.
9. **Generated references, strictness counts (`view.zod.ts` strict sites 60 to 59, `ui/` 214 to 213), `variant-docs.json` key `provider:object|schema|value` — RIGHT**, subject to item 5 (the `component.mdx` rows regenerate again once the describes are fixed).
10. **Tests and fixtures — RIGHT.** The retirement pin covers refusal at three doors with the prescription, the surviving arms value-for-value and still closed, zod's default report for other providers, the D3 registration, the absence of any `ui/ViewData:*` key row, and a tree-scoped absence walk whose matcher is proven on positives, on the page element's `dataSource` as a negative, and on prose; it joins `vitest.repo-tests.json` and is the second witness on the fifteen per-extension rows in `scripts/cross-package-test-inputs.mjs` (`skills/**`, `content/**`, `scripts/**` are declared whole by other rows). The two accept pins in `view.test.ts` become one refusal control, the kanban fixture moves to `value`, the batch-18 strictness row for the arm leaves, and `component-props-unknown-members.pin.test.ts` drops its `HTTP_REQUEST` lines and refuses their return.
11. **Teaching: `content/docs/ui/views.mdx` — RIGHT.** The view-level example leaves; the pointer `/docs/ui/pages#element-data-sources` resolves (`### Element data sources` at `pages.mdx` line 191 on `origin/main`), and the prescription's `regions[].components[]` / `dataSource: { provider: 'api', read: { url }, path? }` spelling matches `page.zod.ts` (components at line 50, `dataSource` at line 696). Outside this diff, the only other view-level `provider: 'api'` sites on `origin/main` are release-owned prose (`content/docs/releases/v16.mdx`) and the page element's own example in `pages.mdx`, both correctly left.
12. **Governed surface `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/list-views.md` (Tier H), judged at this tier — text RIGHT, one omission flagged.** The hunk removes the `provider: 'api'` example and the "Custom API endpoint" line, counts "two providers" for a list view (accurate: `schema` is form-only and was not counted before either), and adds "A view never calls an API: an API read is a page element's `dataSource` binding." Nothing it teaches is refused by the contract. What it omits: the replacement's spelling. The published catalog teaches `dataSource` nowhere — `git grep dataSource origin/main -- skills` is empty, and `rules/pages.md` teaches `regions` and components without the binding — so an author following the pointer finds no example inside the skill; the prescription and `views.mdx` carry it instead. The file's token ceiling (3141; 3136 to 3133 here) leaves no room in this file. Not a defect of this hunk; a Tier H follow-up on `rules/pages.md` (③ item G).

### ② Semver level

`.changeset/23082-view-data-api-provider-retired.md`: `@objectstack/spec: minor`, title `feat(spec)!:`, a **BREAKING** header, a FROM → TO table (both legs and the `headers` key), the one-line fix, the prescription verbatim, the ADR-0087 marker `adr-0087: registered view-data-api-provider-retired`, and the declaration line. **Level matches what the diff publishes — RIGHT**: an accept-set narrowing on a published authoring surface, shipped as `minor` under the repo's launch-window convention (the 17.x CHANGELOG carries the same sentence on at least nine entries); under pre mode the fixed group versions to `18.0.0-next.N` regardless. No `skip-changeset`, correctly: `@objectstack/spec` publishes. `Check Changeset` is green on the head.

`Clause-②:` line — `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` on line 2 of the PR body and in the changeset body: the closed-pair arm the gate reads, consistent with BREAKING, and the dev's deviation from the claim's prose parenthetical is the right call (the claim's `no` is the same value). The version text inside the changeset is the one wrong fact (① item 4).

### ③ Boundary flags

Dev report `6138457534`: `open_questions: []`; `premise_still_valid: true`; six deviations and four out-of-scope findings, each answered:

- **D1 Clause-② spelling** (`no (narrowing)` versus the claim's `no`) — answered: right, the gate's arm spelling; matches the changeset.
- **D2 interrupted run; background jobs read, not re-run** — answered: accepted; the head's check-runs are the gate verdicts, and the families those jobs carry (`Build Core`, `Test Core`, both `Type Check` legs) are still in progress as read above, so nothing in this record assumes them.
- **D3 verify-lock timeouts, `check:skill-examples` NOT MEASURED** — answered: the narrowing argument (neither edited block is `os:check`-marked) is plausible; CI's run is the verdict; same in-progress caveat.
- **D4 nested `client-react` build collision** — answered: own concurrency, no finding.
- **D5 harness refusal of a `bash -c` loop** — answered: re-issued directly, no finding.
- **D6 no MCP writes, no PR-body PATCH, no label writes** — answered: consistent with the PR as read (draft, author `objectstack-fleet[bot]`, assignee `os-justin`, auto-merge off).
- **O1 `check:platform-checklist` main-red** — answered: inherited on `origin/main` and on this branch's base; none of the cited files is in this diff; the triage lane carries it, not this card.
- **O2 `HttpRequestSchema` / `HttpMethodSubsetSchema` orphaned, describes still say "view data sources"** — answered: left per the ruling; cross-repo (objectui `packages/types` imports the schema in a test), carrier the objectui follow-up. ⛔ The four `component.zod.ts` describes (① item 5) are NOT in this class: they are this PR's own teaching surface and are owed here.
- **O3 objectui reader population; approvals route constructs `ApiDataSource` in code** — answered: the follow-up card's population, filed when the spec release is installable (cross-repo unlock rule). Added reading: `Console Pin Gate` is skipped on every PR head by its filter contract, so the dev's "cannot red that gate on a type" is unmeasured until main runs it after merge; the objectui-side `tsc` consequence of the narrowed `ViewData` (any `provider === 'api'` comparison on a spec-typed value) is the follow-up's first step.
- **O4 `sdui.manifest.json` gantt `data` still names the `api` arm** — answered: regenerates with the next pin bump, not here.
- **Fork clause of the ruling** — answered: measured zero producers of a view-level `provider: 'api'` outside documentation in objectstack, objectui and hotcrm with lit controls, zero producers of the `write` leg, cloud NOT MEASURED and covered by the maintainer's word; no fork, the card stays on this PR.

Escalations raised by this review:

- **E. Version stamping under pre mode (kit owner, `spec-property-retirement`).** The skill's sentence rule leaves `[version]` unspecified, and `23042-retired-after-prerelease-stamp` wrote the pre-mode rule for `retiredAfter` only. Six prescriptions since the line opened stamp `17`; this one stamps `17.8.0`. One written rule is owed; this PR follows it once written, or stamps the bare major like its siblings.
- **F. No helper for a discriminated-union arm retirement** (kit owner): `enumWithRetiredValues()` covers `z.enum` only; two union-arm retirements (#17914, this one) now hand-write the map the skill forbids for enums.
- **G. The published skill catalog teaches `dataSource` nowhere** (Tier H follow-up on `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/pages.md`): the replacement this PR points authors at has no spelling inside the catalog.
- **H. Stale pin label** (this PR): ① item 7.

Required before a PASS on the next head: ① items 4, 5 and 7 (three string edits plus `gen:docs`; the pin re-cite), and the in-progress check-runs reported green.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `12f86031637d7aaffe0ce28819166fb55bad8931`
Local-runs: none

Inputs read: card #23082 (body and all 5 comments: triage `6129766256`, ruling `6134088274` letter C, claim `6136106180`, dev reports `6138457534` and `6139676792`), PR #23160 (body, both comments — the docs-drift advisory and the earlier record `6138665801` — the 24-file list, the net diff against the merge base `dc93781c1`, +634 / −250), the 48 check-runs on the head, and `origin/main` objects by `git show` / `git grep` for context. Nothing built, run or re-run. This is the review after the FAIL on `be64fe664`; its three required items are answered first.

**Check-runs on the head as read for this record:** 48 runs, every one `completed`; none `in_progress`, none `failure`. `success`: the five required contexts (`Lint & Repo Gates`, `TypeScript Type Check`, `Test Core`, `Build Core`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`), `Test Core (1/6)` through `(6/6)`, `Type Check · workspace`, `Type Check · debt ledger`, `Type Check · source gates`, `Type Check · consumer gates`, every `Lint ·` leg, `Build Docs`, `Dogfood Regression Gate`, `Spec property liveness`, `Check Changeset`, `Check Documentation Links`, `Flag docs affected by code changes`, the claim and single-writer guards, `Auto Label`, `Check PR Size`. `skipped` by their own filters: `Console Pin Gate` (its `if:` excludes PR heads, so its verdict is not available here), the `Dogfood Regression Gate` matrix row, `Dogfood Verify CLI`, `Temporal Conformance (live PG + MySQL)`, `Packed-tarball smoke (opt-in)`, and one superseded `Check PR Size` / `Auto Label` pair. `Test Core` runs `turbo run test test:repo` (`ci.yml` line 941), so the spec `repo` project that carries the new retirement pin is inside that green. The earlier record's condition "the in-progress check-runs reported green" is met.

### ① Derived judgments

**The three items `6138665801` required for a PASS, each answered:**

- **Item 4, prescription version — FIXED.** `VIEW_DATA_API_PROVIDER_RETIRED` (`view.zod.ts`) now reads `was removed in @objectstack/spec 17 (ADR-0049 enforce-or-remove)`; the pin's `PRESCRIPTION` regex asserts `17 \(ADR-0049`; the changeset's blockquote quotes the same string. Measured here: `git diff a87d8be29 origin/main -- packages/spec/src` (the commit that entered pre mode) adds six prescriptions to the package and all six stamp the bare major `17`; `packages/spec/package.json` on `main` is `17.7.0`, so the FROM column's "17.7 and earlier" stands. This is the form the earlier record offered ("stamps the bare major like its siblings"). The written rule for `[version]` under pre mode is still owed by the kit owner (escalation E, ③).
- **Item 5, four `component.zod.ts` describes — FIXED.** The `data` describes on `ObjectGridPropsSchema`, `ObjectMapPropsSchema`, `ObjectGanttPropsSchema` and `ObjectTreePropsSchema` now read "discriminated on `provider`: object | value | schema"; `content/docs/references/ui/component.mdx` is regenerated in the head commit `12f860316` (four `data` rows). Across every regenerated reference hunk in the diff, no added line names the `api` provider; the removed lines are the former nested `data[provider='api']` shapes and the `ViewData[provider='api'].read` / `.write` tables. `shared/polarity-axes.ts` keeps its source-comment row (cosmetic, as before).
- **Item 7, stale pin label — FIXED.** `packages/spec/liveness/view.json` `list.data.note` now says "measured at 7578323a544e — `.objectui-sha` has since moved to 1fb1ced36243 and the next cross-repo re-measure re-reads it there"; its `evidence` cites `objectui @7578323a544e` (the sha form other rows use; `Spec property liveness` is green); the changeset says "measured at `7578323a544e`"; the PR body's Liveness bullet carries the replacement sentence and names `1fb1ced36243` as the pin on `main`, which `.objectui-sha` confirms at `origin/main` and at the merge base `dc93781c1`. One cosmetic residue: the new test file's header comment still says "a renderer reader EXISTED at the objectui pin" without naming a sha — a source comment, not a contract or published surface; fold in on the next touch.

**The whole net diff on this head, accept set and public surface:**

1. **`ViewDataSchema` loses its `api` arm — RIGHT.** `provider: 'api'` is refused at parse with the prescription on the union's `error` map, keyed on the input's `provider === 'api'`, as an `invalid_union` issue at `provider` / `data.provider` / `list.data.provider`; any other unknown provider keeps zod's own report listing `object`, `value`, `schema`; the three surviving arms are value-identical and still closed (an undeclared key is refused). Ruling C executed on the `ViewDataSchema` branch only: `HttpRequestSchema` / `HttpMethodSubsetSchema` are untouched, still imported at `view.zod.ts` line 87 and re-exported at line 108 (so the import is not orphaned and `Lint · ESLint` is green); `ui/page.zod.ts` and the page element's `ElementApiDataSourceSchema` are not in the file list.
